definitions.full: H6339. pazaz II. [ מָּזַז ] verb be supple, agile (Talmud (rare) מְּזִיזָא hasty ; Arabic be frightened, excited ; Syriac (Lexicons) leap , agile , etc.); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיָּ֫פֹזוּ Gen 49:24 , of arms.
